verses.text: Iri ni ijambo Uhoraho yarungikiye Abisirayeli, arivugishije Malaki.
“Narabakunze,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze. “Ariko murabaza muti: ‘Wadukunze gute?’ ” “Mbega Esawu ntiyavukana na Yakobo?” ni ko Uhoraho abaza. “Ariko nakunze Yakobo,
Esawu we ndamwanka, imisozi yiwe ndayigira agahinga, itongo ryiwe ndariha imbwebwe zo mu bugaragwa.”

Abanyedomu boshobora kuvuga bati: “Naho twahonejwe, tuzosubira twubake ku misaka.” Ariko uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze: “Naho bokwubaka, nzosambura. Igihugu cabo kizokwitwa igihugu c’inkozi z’ibibi, ubwoko Uhoraho yama arakiye ibihe vyose.
Muzobirabisha amaso yanyu, maze muvuge muti: ‘ Uhoraho arahambaye, ububasha bwiwe burenga n’imbibe za Isirayeli.’

Umwana yubaha umuvyeyi, umukozi akubaha shebuja. Nimba ndi umuvyeyi, icubahiro canje kiri hehe? Nimba ndi shobuja, ukunyubaha kwanyu kuri he?” ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose abaza. “Yemwe baherezi, ni mwebwe mutukisha izina ryanje. Ariko murabaza muti: ‘Twatukishije izina ryawe gute?’
Mwaritukishije mu gushikana ku gicaniro canje ibimazi bihumanye. Ariko mukabaza muti: ‘Twahumanije dute ibimazi?’ Mwabihumanije mu kuvuga muti: ‘Igicaniro c’ Uhoraho nta gaciro kigira.’

Iyo mushikanye ibitungwa bihumye nk’ibimazi, mbega ntimuba mukoze nabi? Iyo mushikanye ibicumbagira n’ibigwaye, ntimuba mugize nabi? Mbega mwobishikanira umutware wanyu yobashimira? Mbega yobibakirira?” ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose abaza.
“Ehe nimwinginge Imana ibagirire ubuntu. Ariko mbega yobemera mushikanye ibimazi bimeze bityo?” ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose abaza.

“Vyoba vyiza hagize umwe wo muri mwebwe yugara imiryango y’Ingoro, kugira ngo ntihagire imicanwa icanirwa ubusa ku bicaniro vyanje, kuko sindabanezererewe. Sinzokwakira ibimazi vyanyu,” ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze.

“Izina ryanje rizoba rurangiranwa mu makungu, kuva mu buseruko kugeza mu burengero. Mu mihingo yose bazonshikanira ibimota neza, n’ishikanwa ryejejwe, kuko izina ryanje rizoba ryabaye rurangiranwa mu makungu,” ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze.
“Ariko mwararihumanije aho mwavuga muti: ‘Imeza y’Umwami iranduye, n’ivyokurya vyayo biragayitse.’

Murongera muravuga muti: ‘Gukorera Imana ni umuruho!’ bituma mukura imitima yanyu ku mabwirizwa yanje,” ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze. “Iyo mushikanye ibikoko bikomeretse, canke bicumbagira, canke bigwaye, mukabitanga nk’ibimazi, mbega novyakira mu maboko yanyu?” ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose abaza.

“Haravumwe umuntu afise impfizi y’intama itagira akanenge yo mu mukuku agasezerana kuyitanga, ariko akiba Uhoraho mu kumushikanira ikimazi kitabereye. Ndi Umwami ahambaye, kandi izina ryanje rikwiye kwubahwa mu mahanga yose!” ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze.

headings.text: Ukuva mw’isezerano mu gutanga ibimazi bitabereye

verses.text: “None rero yemwe baherezi, iki ni co cagezwe ndabahaye.

Nimutanyumvira ngo mushire imitima yanyu ku kwubaha izina ryanje, nzobarungikira umuvumo, mvume n’imigisha mwahawe. Mbere naramaze no kuyivuma, kuko mutashize imitima yanyu ku kwubaha izina ryanje,” ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze.
“Nzohana uruvyaro rwanyu kubera mwebwe; nzobatera mu maso amayezi y’ibimazi vyo ku misi mikuru yanyu, hanyuma ndayabatane.
Hanyuma muzoteba mumenye ko ari jewe nabahaye iki cagezwe, kugira ngo isezerano nagiranye na Lewi rize ryameho,” ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze.

“Isezerano ryanje ryari kuri we, kandi ryari isezerano rizana ubuzima bwiza n’amahoro, iryo ni ryo nabahaye; naribahaye kugira ngo banyubahe, ngire igitinyiro kuri bo, kandi baranyubaha cane bagahindira agashitsi izina ryanje.
Inyigisho z’ukuri zama mu kanwa kabo, kandi iminwa yabo yazira ikinyoma. Bagendanye nanje mu mahoro no mu bugororotsi, kandi bakuye benshi mu vyaha.
Kuko iminwa y’umuherezi ikwiye kuzigama ukumenya Imana, kandi akanwa kiwe ni ko kabarizwamwo ivyagezwe, kuko umuherezi ari intumwa y’ Uhoraho Mushoboravyose.
Ariko mwebwe mwarantaye, inyigisho zanyu zicika izigwisha abantu mu vyaha. Mwavuye mw’isezerano rya Lewi,” ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze.
“Ni co catumye nemera ko musuzugurwa, mukagawa n’amoko yose, kuko mutagendeye mu nzira zanje, ahubwo mugahengama ku bijanye n’amabwirizwa yanje.”
Mbega twese ntidusangiye Data? Mbega twese ntitwaremwe n’Imana imwe? None ni kuki duhemukiranira, tukava mw’isezerano rya ba sogokuruza?
Yuda yarampemukiye, kandi igisesema cakorewe muri Isirayeli n’i Yerusalemu. Abayuda bahumanije Ingoro Uhoraho akunda, mu kurongora abagore basenga ibigirwamana.
Nk’umuntu akora ivyo, uwo ari we wese, akwiye gucibwa mw’ihema rya Yakobo, naho yoba ashikanira amashikanwa Uhoraho Mushoboravyose.
Hari ikindi kibi mukora: mwuzuza amarira yanyu ku gicaniro, mukarira muboroga kubera Uhoraho atakiraba ryiza amashikanwa yanyu, canke ngo ayakire ayakunze avuye mu biganza vyanyu.

Mukibaza muti: “Ni kubera iki?” Reka ndababwire igituma: ni kubera Uhoraho yari icabona igihe mwasezerana n’abagore banyu mukagirirana indahiro n’abagore bo mu busore bwanyu. Mwarabahemukiye, kandi ari bo mwafatanye ngo babe abagore banyu b’isezerano.

Mbega Imana ntiyari yabagize umwe n’abagore banyu? Mu mpwemu no mu mubiri muri abiwe. Kandi ico abipfuzako ni iki? Ashaka ko muvyara abana bamwubaha. Nuko rero nimwirinde mugume mw’isezerano mwagiranye n’abagore bo mu buto bwanyu.

“Kuko ndanka ukwahukana,” ni ko Uhoraho Imana ya Isirayeli avuze, “kandi nanka n’umuntu yitwikira umuryano nk’uko yitwikirira umutamana,” ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze. None rero nimurinde imitima yanyu, mwoye guhemukira abagore banyu.

Mwararuhishije Uhoraho mu majambo yanyu. Ariko murabaza muti: “Twamuruhishije dute?” Muvuga muti: “Ibibi vyose ni vyiza mu nyonga z’ Uhoraho , kandi arabinezererwa,” canke mukavuga muti: “Mbega iyo Mana ica izibereye iri hehe?”

“Ehe raba ngira ntume intumwa yanje imbere, kugira ngo integurire inzira. Maze ako kanya Uhoraho muriko murarondera azoheza aze mu Ngoro yiwe, umuvugishwa w’isezerano, uwo mwipfuje, agiye kuza,” ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze.
Ariko none ni nde azokwihanganira umusi w’ukuza kwiwe? Ni nde azoshobora guhagarara imbere yiwe niyaseruka? Kuko azoba ameze nk’umuriro w’umucuzi, canke nk’isabune y’uwumesura impuzu.
Azokwicara nk’uwutyorora ifeza, yeze Abalewi nk’uwukura imyanda ku nzahabu n’ifeza. Uko ni ko Uhoraho azokwironkera abamushikanira mu bugororotsi ibimazi vyemerwa mu nyonga ziwe,
kandi ibimazi vy’Abayuda n’ivy’ab’i Yerusalemu bizosubira vyemerwe n’ Uhoraho , nk’uko yavyemera mu gihe caheze.

“Maze ico gihe nzobacira urubanza. Nzihutira kwagiriza abarozi, abasambanyi hamwe n’ababeshi, abagunga abakozi impembo zabo, abacinyiza abapfakazi, n’impfuvyi, bakabuza inyambukira gutunganirizwa, kandi ntibantinye,” ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze.
“Ndi Uhoraho kandi simpindagurika. Ni co gutuma mwebwe urvyaro rwa Yakobo mutararandurwa.

Uhereye kuva kuri ba sogokuruza, mwamye muta ivyagezwe vyanje, ntimubigenderemwo. Ehe nimungarukeko, nanje nzobagarukako,” ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze. “Ariko muribaza muti: ‘Mbega twokugarukako dute kandi tutigeze tukuvako?’
Mbega hari uwokwiba Imana? Ariko mwebwe mwaranyivye. Kandi muribaza muti: ‘Twakwivye gute?’ Mwanyivye ibigiracumi n’amashikanwa.
Muri musi y’umuvumo mwe n’ihanga ryanyu ryose, kuko munyiba.

Nimuzane ikigiracumi gikwiye mu bubiko bwanje, kugira ngo mu nzu yanje habemwo ivyokurya. Ehe nimubingeragereshe, jewe Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, murabe ko ntugurura imiryango yo mw’ijuru, nkabacuncuburirako imigisha mukabura n’aho muyikwiza.
Nzozitira inzige n’ingwara ntibitere imirima yanyu, kandi inzabibu zanyu ntizizohunguruka ziteze,” ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze.
“Ni ho amahanga yose azobita abahirwe, kuko muzoba igihugu kimpimbara,” ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze.
“Mwamvuzeko amajambo mabi,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze. “Ariko murabaza muti: ‘Ni igiki twakuvuzeko kibi?’
Mwavuze muti: ‘Gukorera Imana nta kamaro bifise. Mbega gukurikiza ivyo idutegeka no mu kwama tuza imbere y’ Uhoraho Mushoboravyose tumeze nk’abagandaye, bitumariye iki?’
Muravuga ngo kuva ubu rero tuzovuga ko abishira hejuru ari bo bahiriwe, ko inkozi z’ibibi ari zo zitera imbere, kandi ko bagerageza Imana ariko ntibagire ico baba.”
Maze abubaha Uhoraho baraganira, Uhoraho na we yumviriza ivyo bavuga. Igitabu c’icibutso gica candikirwa imbere yiwe, candikwamwo amazina y’abo bose bubaha Uhoraho , bagahesha icubahiro izina ryiwe.

“Kuri wa musi, nzocirako imanza,” ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze, “bazoba ari ubutunzi niharije kandi budasanzwe. Nzobazigamira mu mbabazi zanje nk’uko umuvyeyi agirira impuhwe akazigama umwana wiwe amwubaha.
Kandi muzobona ubudasa hagati y’abagororotsi n’abanyakibi, no hagati y’abakorera Imana n’abatayikorera,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze.

“Nta nkeka uwo musi uraje, kandi uje waka nk’itanure. Abibona n’inkozi z’ibibi bazoba nk’ubwatsi bwumye, kandi uwo musi uje uzobatongora,” ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze. “Nta kimeze nk’umuzi canke ishami kizosigara kuri bo.

Ariko mwebwe muhindira agashitsi imbere y’izina ryanje, izuba ry’ubugororotsi rizobarasira, rifise ugukiza mu mishwarara yaryo. Maze muzosohoka mwishire mwizane, mutamba mwiginagura nk’uko inyana ziginagura iyo zisohowe ziva mu ruhongore.
Kandi ku musi nzokorerako ivyo, muzohonyanga inkozi z’ibibi, babe nk’umukungugu musi y’ibirenge vyanyu,” ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze.
Nimwibuke Ivyagezwe vy’umusavyi wanje Mose, amabwirizwa n’ivyagezwe namugereye i Horebu kubw’Abisirayeli bose.
“Raba nzobarungikira Eliya uwuvugishwa n’Imana, imbere y’uko uwo musi w’ Uhoraho uteye ubwoba ushika.
Ubutumwa bwiwe buzosubiza imitima y’abavyeyi ku bana babo, n’imitima y’abana ku bavyeyi babo. Ahandi ho nzoza ndanduze isi umuvumo.”
